## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you decide tomorrow, could you give yourself one night to breathe and think through your options? If the job is harming your health or you feel unsafe, leaving may be the right choice—but you don’t have to handle it alone. Want to talk through what happened and whether there’s a way to take leave, set boundaries, or plan an exit?

## 2

I understand why some space images might seem difficult to verify—most of us can’t go to space ourselves. But the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend on photographs alone. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, Earth casts a round shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses, different stars are visible at different latitudes, and people can circumnavigate the planet. Satellites, GPS, time zones, and measurements made by independent scientists all fit a globe far better than a flat-Earth model. What kind of evidence would you find convincing?

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. Violet is scattered even more, but our eyes are less sensitive to violet, and some violet is absorbed higher in the atmosphere. That is why the daytime sky usually looks blue. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, which scatters away much of the blue and leaves more red and orange light for us to see.

## 4

雨落在深夜的城市里，像一层细密的帘子，遮住了远处的灯火。街道空荡荡的，积水映着昏黄的路灯，被风吹得微微发颤。屋檐不时滴下一串水珠，落在台阶上，发出清脆而孤单的声响。窗内有人翻动书页，暖光安静地铺在地板上。雨声把喧闹洗淡了，整座城市仿佛暂时放下疲惫，在湿润的黑暗中缓缓呼吸。
